run_finetune_enc_t5_classifier: run the EncT5 sequence classification model fine-tuning script with training and validation CSV or JSON data files
run_enc_t5_evaluation: run evaluation on a validation dataset using the EncT5 model and compute accuracy metrics
run_enc_t5_prediction: run predictions on a test dataset and save results and softmax scores to output files
create_data_training_arguments: create a DataTrainingArguments dataclass to configure dataset paths, max sequence length, and padding strategy for training
create_model_arguments: create a ModelArguments dataclass to configure the pretrained model path, tokenizer, and early stopping patience
